learning_target: Count a visible quantity; connect it to a numeral
interaction_as_found: Tap countable objects, then choose a number
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate counting once per object and what the number cards mean; introduce zero explicitly
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the instruction; number recognition is a learning prerequisite, not reading prose

interaction_as_found: Choose a numeric answer beside object groups and equation
guidance_to_design: Show one combining or removing example; make + and − meaningful before relying on them
audio_and_reading_policy: Read the operation if needed without giving the total
beginner_route_status: Candidate when the number concept fits

interaction_as_found: Choose a pictorial next item
guidance_to_design: Show a separate repeating unit and a fresh arrangement; teach new rule variants when needed
audio_and_reading_policy: Short instruction; no reading target

interaction_as_found: Choose an image or labelled answer
guidance_to_design: Speak the question and ensure every answer is understandable pictorially; review text-heavy habitat choices
audio_and_reading_policy: Spoken question is essential guidance

learning_target: Read syllables, words or sentences in four modes
interaction_as_found: Select or manipulate printed language with picture support
guidance_to_design: Explain the action orally; review Silben-Puzzle, Wort und Bild, Silben-Ballone and Lies genau separately
audio_and_reading_policy: Do not automatically pronounce the printed target when decoding it is the task; assisted practice is a separate policy
beginner_route_status: Reading is a learning target; optional for the pre-reader story route

interaction_as_found: Trace from a visual start using the displayed model
guidance_to_design: Retain the model and start cues; demonstrate one stroke and the finish action
audio_and_reading_policy: Naming the symbol can support formation; prose reading unnecessary

interaction_as_found: Connect the next numbered point
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate the gesture and next-point cue; number recognition remains part of the target skill
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the rule and appropriate number support
beginner_route_status: Candidate when numerical sequencing is appropriate

learning_target: Complete a quantity or number bond
interaction_as_found: Tap empty places and confirm
guidance_to_design: Show filling and undoing one place; replace a written start instruction with demonstrated action
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the goal; exact numeral support depends on stage

interaction_as_found: Tap plates to distribute, undo and check
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate one item going to each plate and how to undo; show the remaining group
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the sharing goal; text labels are additional
beginner_route_status: Candidate after a concrete sharing example

interaction_as_found: View equal groups and choose a total
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate what both equal groups mean; support numeric choices appropriately
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the question, not the computed result
beginner_route_status: Candidate when the number concept fits

learning_target: Recognise shape names, properties or rotations
interaction_as_found: Choose a drawn shape
guidance_to_design: Use a spoken target and separate example; review each mode so a hint does not silently answer the live task
audio_and_reading_policy: Spoken shape/property prompt; no prose reading needed

interaction_as_found: Choose among currently written words
guidance_to_design: Provide recognisable choices and pronounce target/options; demonstrate a different rhyming pair
audio_and_reading_policy: Hearing words is the learning content; sound is required for this route

interaction_as_found: Tap drum beats, undo and check
guidance_to_design: Speak the pictured word; demonstrate beats on another word and the undo control
audio_and_reading_policy: Spoken word is part of the activity; avoid relying on reading it
beginner_route_status: Auditory activity; needs word recordings and demo

learning_target: Reason about directions and a route
interaction_as_found: Arrow taps move the robot immediately; reaching the goal succeeds
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate the goal, a legal arrow move and undo; distinguish this flat arrow interaction from world walking
audio_and_reading_policy: Short spoken direction guidance

interaction_as_found: Tap cards into a sequence and check
guidance_to_design: Show a separate two-step example, visible sequence positions and reset
audio_and_reading_policy: Narrate the situation; choices need picture support

interaction_as_found: Look, choose when to hide, select an answer; look again is allowed
guidance_to_design: Teach basket/hide and eye/look-again separately; preserve the same trial when replaying
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the phases without naming the missing answer

interaction_as_found: Choose an active house then assign numbers
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate one house at a time and the active slot; replace dependence on written before/after labels
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the rule; number ordering is the target skill

interaction_as_found: View groups and choose a labelled relation
guidance_to_design: Make the selectable relation pictorial and demonstrate equality separately
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak more/less/equal; do not require reading left/right labels

learning_target: Reflect a pattern across an axis
interaction_as_found: Toggle cells, undo, clear and check
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate an asymmetric example across the visible mirror line; show toggling and check controls
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak one action at a time; pictures carry the spatial rule

learning_target: Use a known sum for a related sum
interaction_as_found: Compare equations and optional object support; choose a number
guidance_to_design: Demonstrate the specific transformation; keep quantity support available appropriately
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the operation when useful; preserve the computation as the task
beginner_route_status: Candidate when the number concept fits

learning_target: Connect spoken sounds and written vowels
interaction_as_found: Choose a letter for a pictured incomplete word
guidance_to_design: Speak the pictured word where intended; teach the missing-letter action on another item
audio_and_reading_policy: Pronouncing the word may be valid support; spelling or naming the missing letter would answer it
beginner_route_status: Letter/orthographic target; optional for the initial story route

interaction_as_found: Read a pictorial chart and choose a number/category
guidance_to_design: Teach one mark as one vote; introduce count, most/least, total and difference as distinct variants
audio_and_reading_policy: Speak the selected question; category pictures identify what to inspect
